textos.Ahora mismo no puede entrar (%(motivo)s: They cannot get in right now (%(motivo)s): if they are connected, they will be disconnected in under a minute.
%(cn)s will move to the deleted profiles. Its certificate stays revoked and in the CRL: it is hidden from the list, not removed from the PKI. Continue?
'%(cn)s' was not in the deleted profiles.
textos.'%(cn)s' no está en la lista de clientes: '%(cn)s' is not in the list of clients.
'%(cn)s' moves to the deleted profiles. Their certificate stays revoked and in the CRL: it is hidden from the list, not removed from the PKI.
textos.'%(cn)s' sigue teniendo un certificado v: '%(cn)s' still has a valid certificate. Revoke it first: otherwise it would disappear from the list while keeping its access.
'%(cn)s' is back in the list of clients.
textos.'%(usuario)s' ahora es %(rol)s. Deberá v: '%(usuario)s' is now %(rol)s. They will have to sign in again.
textos.'%(usuario)s' es el superusuario: solo e: '%(usuario)s' is the superuser: only that account can administer itself. From the server there is the CLI.
textos.'%(usuario)s' ya tenía el rol %(rol)s: n: '%(usuario)s' already had the %(rol)s role: nothing was changed.
textos.<strong>Descárgale un <code>.ovpn</code>: Download them a new .ovpn: the current one does not ask for a code.
textos.<strong>El pool ocupa toda la red</stron: The pool takes up the whole network: to use fixed IPs it has to be trimmed with server … nopool plus ifconfig-pool.
textos.<strong>Los <code>.ovpn</code> que repar: The .ovpn files you handed out before no longer work, so these clients will not be able to connect until they receive a new one.
textos.Abre Google Authenticator, Aegis, FreeOT: Open Google Authenticator, Aegis, FreeOTP or whichever you use
textos.Abre tu aplicación de autenticación y es: Open your authenticator app and enter the code for %(usuario)s.
textos.Acceso de '%(cn)s' revocado y CRL regene: Access for '%(cn)s' revoked and the CRL regenerated. Restart %(servicio)s to apply it.
textos.Aceptar: ya los he repartido: Accept: I have handed them out
textos.Además del certificado, pide al conectar: On top of the certificate, it asks for the 6-digit code from an app like Google Authenticator or Aegis when connecting. A stolen .ovpn is no longer enough: you also need their phone. It is only asked for on connect, not on every key renewal.
They cannot get in right now: %(motivo)s.
textos.Al conectar, su cliente pedirá usuario y: When connecting, their client will ask for a username and a password: the username does not matter (let them use %(cn)s) and the password is the code from the app.
textos.Al cumplirla se le desconecta y tiene qu: When it is met they are disconnected and have to connect again; if their certificate has a password, they will have to type it again. Empty or 0 = the global one (%(global)s).
textos.Alta descartada. Borra la cuenta antigua: Setup discarded. Delete the old account from your app before starting another: the previous key no longer works.
textos.Aviso retirado. Todos los perfiles se de: Notice removed. All the profiles were downloaded.
textos.Bloqueado por el panel (%(bloqueo)s). Se: Blocked by the panel (%(bloqueo)s). It lifts on its own when the condition is no longer met.
textos.Cada administrador activa el suyo desde: Each administrator enables their own from their profile; you cannot impose it on anyone from here. What you can decide is whether accounts with the %(rol)s role are required to use it.
textos.Cada franja necesita al menos un día: Each time window needs at least one day
textos.Certificado de '%(cn)s' reemitido. Desca: Certificate for '%(cn)s' reissued. Download the new .ovpn: the previous one no longer works.
textos.Cifrar la clave privada con contraseña: Encrypt the private key with a password
textos.Cliente '%(cn)s' creado con la clave pri: Client '%(cn)s' created with the private key encrypted. You will be asked for the password when connecting, so give it through a channel other than the file itself.
Client '%(cn)s' created without a password. Careful: their .ovpn is direct access to the VPN for whoever gets hold of the file.
textos.Con IP fija recibe siempre la misma dire: With a fixed IP they always get the same address inside the VPN.
textos.Con contraseña, OpenVPN la pide al conec: With a password, OpenVPN asks for it when connecting and the file on its own is not enough. Give it to whoever uses the profile through a channel other than the .ovpn itself. It cannot be recovered: if it is lost, the certificate has to be reissued.
Password for '%(usuario)s' updated. Their sessions have been closed.
textos.Cuenta blindada: al superusuario solo lo: Locked account: the superuser is only administered by themselves.
textos.Cuentas que entran a este panel. No conf: Accounts that sign in to this panel. Do not confuse them with VPN clients.
textos.Código QR con la clave de %(cn)s: QR code with the key for %(cn)s
textos.Código QR para dar de alta %(usuario)s e: QR code to add %(usuario)s to your authenticator app
textos.Código incorrecto. Comprueba la hora del: Incorrect code. Check your phone's time and try again.
textos.Da de alta la cuenta en tu aplicación y: Add the account in your app and enter a code to finish.
textos.Desde esa fecha no podrá conectar, quien: From that date they cannot connect, whoever is inside is disconnected, and their certificate is revoked automatically. Empty = permanent access.
textos.Desmárcala para clientes desatendidos —u: Untick it for unattended clients —a router, a server— that have to reconnect on their own: nobody would be there to type it.
textos.Destino no válido: '%(destino)s'. Se esc: Invalid destination: '%(destino)s'. Write it as 192.168.1.0/24, 192.168.1.10 or 192.168.1.10:443/tcp
textos.Duración máxima de sesión fuera de rango: Maximum session length out of range
textos.Duración máxima fuera de rango: Maximum session length out of range
textos.Duración máxima global fuera de rango: Global maximum session length out of range
textos.Día de la semana no válido en una franja: Invalid day of the week in a time window
textos.El acceso temporal de '%(cn)s' caducó el: The temporary access for '%(cn)s' expired on %(fecha)s. Extend or remove the expiry in their policies before restoring it.
textos.El helper no devolvió contenido para %(c: The helper returned no content for %(cn)s.ovpn
textos.El helper no respondió en %(segundos)s s: The helper did not respond within %(segundos)s seconds
textos.El horario debe ser una lista de franjas: The schedule must be a list of time windows
textos.El management no confirmó la desconexión: The management interface did not confirm the disconnection
textos.El nombre de usuario no puede superar 64: The username cannot be longer than 64 characters
textos.El secreto no es base32 válido: The secret is not valid base32
textos.El segundo factor deja de ser obligatori: The second factor is no longer mandatory for the %(rol)s role.
textos.El segundo factor ya está activo en esta: The second factor is already active on this account.
textos.El segundo factor ya está activo: aquí n: The second factor is already active: there is nothing to discard here.
textos.El servidor aún no puede pedir el código: The server cannot ask for the code yet. Add this to the server.conf and restart OpenVPN:

textos.El servidor no aceptó la política: %(err: The server did not accept the policy: %(error)s
textos.El servidor pasó a <code>tls-crypt-v2</c: The server moved to tls-crypt-v2: each profile now carries its own key, and OpenVPN clients 2.6 or later are required.
textos.El status no da la hora de conexión en u: The status file does not show the connection time in a recognisable format
textos.ElectroBridges Solutions — abre en una p: ElectroBridges Solutions — opens in a new tab

textos.Error leyendo del management: %(error)s: Error reading from the management interface: %(error)s
textos.Escribe abajo el código que te muestre,: Enter the code it shows below, to confirm the setup worked.
textos.Falta el paquete 'segno'. Instálalo con: The 'segno' package is missing. Install it with 'pip install -r requirements.txt' to see the QR; meanwhile, register the account by writing the key by hand.
textos.Fuera de estas franjas no puede conectar: Outside these time windows they cannot connect, and whoever is inside is disconnected when their window closes. Server time. No time windows = at any time. To finish at midnight put 00:00; if a window crosses midnight, split it into two.
textos.Guarda la clave en sitio seguro antes de: Save the key somewhere safe before you continue: it is not shown again. If you lose it, an administrator will have to reset your second factor.
textos.Hay perfiles pendientes de repartir: There are profiles waiting to be handed out
textos.IP fija asignada a más de un cliente: %(: Fixed IP assigned to more than one client: %(ips)s
textos.La caducidad tiene que ser una fecha fut: The expiry must be a date in the future
textos.La contraseña debe tener al menos 12 car: The password must be at least 12 characters long
textos.La contraseña del certificado debe tener: The certificate password must be at least %(n)s characters long
textos.La contraseña del certificado no puede t: The certificate password cannot contain line breaks
textos.La cuota tiene que ser un número de GB: The quota has to be a number of GB
textos.La duración máxima tiene que ser un núme: The maximum session length must be a number of minutes
textos.La franja %(desde)s–%(hasta)s termina an: The window %(desde)s–%(hasta)s ends before it starts. If it crosses midnight, split it into two (until 24:00 and from 00:00).
textos.La franja %(n)s necesita hora de inicio: Time window %(n)s needs a start and an end time
textos.La franja %(n)s tiene horas pero ningún: Time window %(n)s has times but no days
textos.La política debe ser un mapa: The policy must be a dictionary
textos.La tabla se actualiza sola cada 10 segun: The table refreshes itself every 10 seconds.
textos.La verificación ha caducado. Entra otra: The verification has expired. Sign in again.
textos.Las contraseñas del certificado no coinc: The certificate passwords do not match
textos.Las políticas no se aplican al conectar:: The policies are not applied on connect: %(detalle)s. Until that is fixed, whoever is left out is disconnected every minute, but their client will get back in on its own. Add to the server.conf: script-security 2 and client-connect /usr/local/lib/ovpn-web/client-connect, and restart OpenVPN.

textos.Limitar los destinos exige asignarle una: Limiting destinations requires assigning a fixed IP
textos.Los nombres entre paréntesis están reser: Names in parentheses are reserved for the panel itself

textos.No puedes cambiar tu propio rol: que lo: You cannot change your own role: another account has to do it

textos.Puedes cambiarla desde <a href=\"/admin/: You can change it from Users, or on the server with python -m app.cli cambiar-password %(usuario)s.

textos.Que %(cn)s la escanee con su app, o que: Have %(cn)s scan it with their app, or type it in:

textos.Se generará una clave nueva y la de su a: A new key will be generated and the one in their app will stop working. Continue?

They are asked for the code when connecting.
textos.Se reemitirá el certificado de %(cn)s. E: The certificate for %(cn)s will be reissued. The previous .ovpn will stop working. Continue?
textos.Se te pide un código cada vez que entras: You are asked for a code every time you sign in.
textos.Segundo factor activado. A partir de aho: Second factor enabled. From now on you will be asked for a code when signing in.
textos.Segundo factor de '%(usuario)s' restable: Second factor for '%(usuario)s' reset and their sessions closed. They will have to set it up again.
textos.Segundo factor exigido a las cuentas de: Second factor required for accounts with the %(rol)s role. Those without it will only be able to go to their profile until they enable it.
textos.Si prefieres no escanear, introduce la c: If you prefer not to scan, enter the key by hand:
textos.Siguen revocados y en la CRL, así que su: They stay revoked and in the CRL, so their .ovpn files do not work. They are not removed from the PKI on purpose: the CRL is regenerated from index.txt every time someone is revoked, and taking a certificate out of there would give it back its validity in that next regeneration. They can be deleted for good when the CA is rebuilt, once they are signed by an authority that no longer exists and there is nothing left to block.

textos.Sin permisos para leer %(ruta)s. El usua: No permission to read %(ruta)s. The service user must belong to the 'adm' group.
textos.Solo se permiten letras, números, punto,: Only letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore are allowed, starting and ending with a letter or a digit
textos.Solo se te pide la contraseña para entra: You are only asked for your password to sign in.
textos.Subida más bajada. Al agotarla se le des: Upload plus download. When it runs out they are disconnected and cannot get back in until the 1st of the following month, when it is lifted automatically. Empty = no quota.

textos.Tu rol no permite esta acción: Your role does not allow this action
textos.Un administrador ha impuesto el segundo: An administrator has imposed the second factor on accounts with your role, so you cannot disable it.
An administrator has imposed the second factor on accounts with your role. Enable it to use the panel.
An administrator has imposed the second factor on your role: you cannot disable it.
textos.Un código de 6 dígitos que cambia cada 3: A 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds, generated by an app on your phone. If someone steals your password, it is not enough on its own.
textos.Una franja no puede empezar a las 24:00: A time window cannot start at 24:00
textos.Uno por línea: <code>192.168.1.0/24</cod: One per line: 192.168.1.0/24, 192.168.1.10 or 192.168.1.10:443/tcp. If you set any, only those will be reachable, the server itself included. Empty = no limit. It requires a fixed IP.

textos.¿Perdiste la clave o no llegaste a guard: Did you lose the key or never get to save it? Discard this setup and start another. The previous key will stop working.
